title: Domino L2
tagline: You'll get your withdrawls in 30 minutes: just like Domino's!
description: This is a Layer 2 blockchain solution constructed using the OP-Stack, a highly efficient and scalable framework designed for enhancing the capabilities of blockchain networks. One of the key improvements introduced with this Layer 2 chain is the significant reduction in the withdrawal period, which has been dramatically shortened to just 30 minutes. This expedited process, while reducing the time window for the challenge period, offers substantial benefits for developers and users alike, particularly those who are building and managing services that require rapid access to funds. The shortened withdrawal period enhances the overall user experience and service efficiency.
how_its_made: This project was developed using Conduit. As part of the development process, several adjustments were made to optimize performance and user experience. One of the most significant modifications includes the reduction of withdrawal periods, which has been carefully implemented to ensure quicker access to funds. These enhancements contribute to a more seamless and responsive platform, meeting the needs of developers and users alike.
